p8_b0.ocr: In the Asia-Pacific professional report covering AbbVie’s real-world evidence studies, we observe a variety of Clinical Trials across years 2020, 2021, and 2022. The Efficacy Study in 2020 recorded 150 cases with 5% observational studies costing CNY10M, yielding positive outcomes for DrugA and was completed. In 2021, the Efficacy Study increased to 200 cases with 7% observational studies at a cost of CNY15M, also positive for DrugB, and completed.

p8_b1.ocr: The Safety Study in 2020 had 100 cases with 3% observational studies costing CNY5M, resulting in neutral outcomes for DrugC and was ongoing. In 2021, the Safety Study recorded 120 cases with 4% observational studies costing CNY7M, achieving positive outcomes for DrugD, and was completed. The Cost-Effectiveness Study in 2020 involved 90 cases with 2% observational studies costing CNY4M, which was negative for DrugE and completed, while in 2021, it had 110 cases with 3% observational studies costing CNY6M, remaining neutral for DrugF and ongoing.
